# Pixel events Please find all the 18 Web events in the following table. ```xtable |Event name for ad creation (optimization_event){25%}|Event name for event data connection (event){25%}|Description{25%}|Recommended fields
in properties object{25%}| |---|---|---|---| |`ON_WEB_DETAIL`|ViewContent|When a page is viewed.|`content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value`| |`ON_WEB_SEARCH`|Search|When a search is made.| | |`ON_WEB_ADD_TO_WISHLIST`| AddToWishlist|When an item is added to a wishlist.|| |`ON_WEB_CART`|AddToCart|When an item is added to the shopping cart.|`content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value`| |`INITIATE_ORDER`|InitiateCheckout|When the checkout process is started.|| |`ADD_BILLING`|AddPaymentInfo|When payment information is added in the checkout flow.|| |`SHOPPING`|Purchase|When a payment is completed.|`content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value`| |`CONSULT`|Contact|When contact or consultation occurs.| | |`DOWNLOAD_START`|Download|When a button to open an external browser download page is clicked.|| |`FORM`|Lead|When a form is submitted.|| |`ON_WEB_REGISTER`|CompleteRegistration|When a registration is completed.|| |`ON_WEB_SUBSCRIBE`| Subscribe|When a subscription is made.|| | | CustomizeProduct | When someone customizes a product. | | | | FindLocation | When someone tries to find your location. | | | | Schedule | When someone makes an appointment to speak with your business or visit your location. | | | | ApplicationApproval | When an application is approved. | | | | StartTrial | When someone begins a free trial of a product or service. | `currency`, `value` | | | SubmitApplication| When someone submits an application | | | | LandingPageView| When a user successfully enters the landing page after clicking an ad. | | | | EngagedSession| When a user clicks on an ad and then stays on the landing page for more than 10 seconds or visits a second-level page. | | ```
